definitions.full: H143. Adar אֲדָר proper noun [masculine] 12th (Babylonian) month = Feb.-Mar. (late Hebrew loan-word, = Babylonian A(d)-daru see Dl Wp. 188 , compare Al 3 93, meaning dubious perhaps adâru , be darkened, eclipsed , but see Dl W p. 190 ) Est 3:7 , 12 ; 8:12 ; 9:1 , 15 , 17 , 19 , 21 ; compare Palmyrene, Nabataean אדר Vog 8 Eut Nab 24 . אֲדָר (K § 57 a ) proper name 12th month (Biblical Hebrew id .); — Ezra 6:15 .
definitions.rootNote: probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire;
